content.value: Suppose a sender and receiver are using a pipelined protocol, i.e., Go Back-N or (05) [CO3] Selective Repeat. In this specific case, the rate at which the sender process pushes data receiver is less than the rate at which then sender consumes data. We want to introduce a buffer in the receiving side. Is it a wise decision? Explain the reasoning behind your answer.
